prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic biographical movie poster celebrating LEONARDO with the subtitle A LIFE IN ROLES, showing the actor's evolution through iconic dramatic roles across decades.

Canvas: Landscape poster, 4:3 aspect ratio, dark teal-black smoky background with subtle film grain, soft vignette, high-contrast studio lighting, polished prestige-documentary aesthetic.

Layout: Place a huge realistic side-profile portrait of the actor on the right half, facing right, serious expression, slicked-back hair, warm rim light on forehead, nose, cheek, and jaw. On the left half, build a layered collage of exactly 11 smaller character portraits arranged in a vertical cluster around the main face: 1 overweight military pilot wearing a green uniform, peaked cap, headset microphone, and medals at upper left; 2 stern man in black tuxedo with bow tie behind him; 3 young clean-cut man in a gray suit and tie; 4 energetic tuxedoed man shouting while holding a champagne coupe; 5 casually dressed man with curly hair at lower left; 6 rugged adventurer with long hair, beard, and tan wide-brim hat; 7 intense long-haired bearded frontiersman in heavy fur coat at bottom center; 8 curly-haired man in dark vest and shirt; 9 smiling woman in a bucket-style hat and outdoor jacket; 10 elderly white-haired man in a gray jacket; 11 elegant dark-haired woman in a gray coat. The collage should feel like a museum-quality montage, with realistic scale overlap, atmospheric haze, and directional highlights.

Foreground props: In the lower-left corner, show exactly 2 objects: an open vintage pocket watch with chain and Roman numerals, and a small hatchet/axe lying diagonally over dark red blood-splatter graphics. Add splashes and streaks of deep crimson behind these props, but keep the overall poster sophisticated rather than gory.

Right-side text and timeline: At the upper right, set the title in tall condensed cream-colored uppercase typography: LEONARDO. Directly below it, smaller uppercase text: A LIFE IN ROLES. Beneath, create a thin vertical timeline with small circular nodes and two small decorative icons, listing exactly 4 labeled eras in stacked cream uppercase text: YOUTH 1990s, ASCENT 2000s, EXCESS 2010s 2010s, SURVIVAL 2020s. Keep the odd repeated 2010s text visible as part of the design.

Bottom text and awards: Near the lower right, add a centered pull quote in cream uppercase: HE DOESN'T JUST PLAY CHARACTERS, HE HOLDS UP A MIRROR TO THE CENTURY!. Under it, include exactly 2 laurel award badges: left badge reads ACADEMY AWARD WINNER, right badge reads A CAREER FOR THE AGES with tiny secondary text beneath. Add two faint signature-like scribbles along the bottom edge.

Visual style: Ultra-realistic celebrity-poster compositing, dramatic chiaroscuro, muted cream typography, desaturated teal and charcoal palette with warm skin tones, subtle scratches and dust, sharp faces with cinematic depth of field. No modern UI elements, no watermark, no extra people, no extra timeline categories.

promptZh:
目标：创作一张电影感传记海报，以庆祝 LEONARDO，副标题为 A LIFE IN ROLES，展示该演员跨越数十年的标志性戏剧角色演变。

画布：横向海报，4:3 纵横比，深青黑色烟雾背景，带有细微的胶片颗粒感，柔和的晕影，高对比度影棚灯光，精致的纪录片美学风格。

布局：在右半部分放置一张演员巨大的写实侧脸肖像，面朝右侧，表情严肃，头发后梳，前额、鼻子、脸颊和下颌处有温暖的轮廓光。在左半部分，构建一个由 11 个较小角色肖像组成的层叠拼贴画，围绕主脸垂直排列：1 左上方是一名身穿绿色制服、戴大檐帽、耳机麦克风并佩戴勋章的超重军用飞行员；2 他身后是一名身穿黑色燕尾服、系领结的严肃男子；3 一名身穿灰色西装打领带的年轻利落男子；4 一名精力充沛、手持香槟杯大喊的燕尾服男子；5 左下方是一名卷发、着装随意的男子；6 一名留着长发、胡须、戴棕褐色宽檐帽的粗犷冒险家；7 底部中央是一名留长发、蓄胡须、身穿厚重皮草大衣的强悍边疆拓荒者；8 一名身穿深色背心和衬衫的卷发男子；9 一名戴着渔夫帽、身穿户外夹克的微笑女性；10 一名身穿灰色夹克、白发苍苍的老年男子；11 一名身穿灰色大衣、优雅的深发女性。拼贴画应呈现出博物馆级的蒙太奇效果，具有真实的比例重叠、大气雾感和方向性高光。

前景道具：在左下角，展示 2 件物品：一块带有链条和罗马数字的打开的复古怀表，以及一把斜放在深红色血迹图形上的小斧头。在这些道具后方添加深红色的飞溅和条纹，但保持整体海报的精致感，避免过于血腥。

右侧文字与时间轴：在右上角，设置高耸、压缩的奶油色大写排版标题：LEONARDO。在其正下方，放置较小的全大写副标题：A LIFE IN ROLES。下方创建一个细长的垂直时间轴，带有小圆点和两个小型装饰图标，列出 4 个以奶油色大写文字堆叠标注的时代：YOUTH 1990s、ASCENT 2000s、EXCESS 2010s 2010s、SURVIVAL 2020s。保留重复的 2010s 文字作为设计的一部分。

底部文字与奖项：在右下角附近，添加一句居中的奶油色大写引言：HE DOESN'T JUST PLAY CHARACTERS, HE HOLDS UP A MIRROR TO THE CENTURY!。在引言下方，包含 2 个桂冠奖项徽章：左侧徽章写着 ACADEMY AWARD WINNER，右侧徽章写着 A CAREER FOR THE AGES，下方有微小的辅助文字。在底部边缘添加两个模糊的签名式涂鸦。

视觉风格：超写实的明星海报合成，戏剧性的明暗对比，柔和的奶油色排版，去饱和的青色与炭灰色调，搭配温暖的肤色，细微的划痕与灰尘，面部清晰且具有电影般的景深。无现代 UI 元素，无水印，无额外人物，无额外时间轴类别。
